customManagers.description: Update the version-tag and digest pins of the distribution matrix images in test/distribution/images

packageRules.description: Alpine base image: never automerge. Containerfile.alpine pins package versions from a specific Alpine release (depName=alpine_X_Y/...), and Renovate cannot derive those annotations from the base image. An automerged minor bump would leave them naming the previous release, which check-alpine-pins fails on and a release build would fail on later. A human moves the pair together.
